name: tms-kit-scaffold
description: Runnable scaffold for a competency-based Training Management System. Vendor-neutral: no operator, authority or product identity anywhere.
//: EVERY script reads --env-file-if-exists=.env, NEVER --env-file=.env. On a workstation .env exists and is loaded. In a container it does not and must not: the environment is supplied by compose, and a secrets file has no business inside an image. Node treats a MISSING --env-file as a fatal error, so the plain form made every migration and seed script unrunnable in the container - before it reached the database, with an ENOENT that named the file and nothing about why it was absent.

scripts.reset:clean: npm run migrate -- --to 0146 && npm run config:load && npm run migrate && npm run seed:framework && npm run seed:operator && npm run seed:library && npm run seed:program && npm run publish:programs && npm run seed:roster && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/create-user.mjs admin_av operator_admin
scripts.verify:clean: node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/neutrality-scan.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/verify.mjs --group schema && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/verify.mjs --group config && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/verify.mjs --group framework && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/verify.mjs --group access
